reranked_evidence.title: Coronavirus: Is the epidemic finally coming to an end in India?
reranked_evidence.snippet: # Coronavirus: Is the epidemic finally coming to an end in India? Reuters A man walks past a graffiti of a girl wearing a protective mask amidst the spread of the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) on a street in Navi Mumbai, India January 21, 2021.Reuters. Case numbers and deaths have been swiftly dropping in India. **Is the sharp drop in India's coronavirus cases as** dramatic **and** curious **as some believe?**. Is the epidemic firmly in retreat in a country where many early modellers had predicted millions of deaths due to Covid-19? Cases had hit a record peak in the middle of September - there were more than a million active cases. So far, India has recorded more than 10 million infections - the second-highest in the world after the US. It is also clear that the decline in cases is not because of lower testing. Also, it has seen a high proportion of cases and deaths of people above the age of 65 living in densely packed cities, hewing to infection trends around the world.
